import re
all_user='\n'.join(usertexts)
def extract(label):
    m=re.search(re.escape(label)+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n?)+)', all_user)
    assert m, label
    hh,ww=map(int,m.group(1,2))
    rows=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in m.group(3).strip().splitlines()]
    assert len(rows)==hh and all(len(r)==ww for r in rows),(label,len(rows),[len(r) for r in rows])
    return rows
for k in (1,2):
    inp=extract(f'Demo pair {k} input')
    exp=extract(f'Demo pair {k} output')
    got=transform(inp)
    diffs=[(r,c,got[r][c],exp[r][c]) for r in range(len(inp)) for c in range(len(inp[0])) if got[r][c]!=exp[r][c]]
